observations: Photo 0 shows a used automatic transmission/gearbox assembly with bell housing, torque converter (blue colored), and bolt pattern visible.
No manufacturer tag, part number, or VIN-matching plate is legible in the photo.
A watermark reading something like 'AUTO SPARE PARTS' overlays the image; this is a seller/shop watermark, not proof of identity.
Surface shows oil residue/grime consistent with a used, unclean part; no visible cracks or major damage.
No wiring harness connector is clearly visible to count pins.
No fluid pan, dipstick, or solenoid pack shown to assess internal condition.

claims.evidence: No tag, stamp, or part number visible in photo 0 to confirm make/model or country of origin.
No wiring connector is visible in photo 0 to count pins.
No part number or casting code visible to cross-check compatible years.
Subjective claim; no test, fluid check, or shift demonstration shown.

risks.risk: Internal wear or failure (clutch packs, solenoids, mechatronic unit) not visible from outside casing
risks.proof: Video of unit being bench-tested or installed and shifting through gears, plus fluid pan drop photo showing debris/metal shavings

risks.risk: Incorrect fitment (wrong generation, engine code mismatch) despite seller's year claim
risks.proof: Clear photo of casting number/part number tag on the transmission case
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed fitment, same as generic used unit

risks.risk: Connector pin count mismatch with buyer's vehicle harness
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the wiring connector showing pin count

risks.risk: Fluid leaks from seals or torque converter
risks.proof: Photo of seals and torque converter hub area, and of any fluid stains on the unit or where it was stored
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential leak issue

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history and reason for removal unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the donor vehicle or any accompanying paperwork/receipt
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown history, same as worst case used unit

proof_requests: Clear photo of the part number/casting tag on the transmission case
Close-up photo of the wiring harness connector showing pin count
Video of the unit being tested (bench test or installed, shifting through gears)
Photo of the fluid pan area and torque converter seal for leak signs
Photo of the donor vehicle or paperwork confirming Camry origin and year
response.reason: The photo shows a genuine used automatic transmission assembly, so it can be identified by type and priced at worst case as an unverified, untested used unit with unconfirmed make/model fitment; none of the seller's specific claims (Camry origin, pin count, model years, condition) are visible or provable from the single photo.
